|translation='''Title:''' Tactical Support.

'''Card text:'''
Lose 1 Force to search your Reserve Deck for up to 3 personnel or troopers and take them into hand. Then shuffle and cut the Reserve Deck and return it to its place.

'''Lore:'''
Highly trained Imperial infantry units can advance at astonishing speed and attack one-sidedly by catching the enemy off guard.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The printed title is Tactical Support Unit (戦術支援部隊).
